WITH RECURSIVE pool_tree AS ( SELECT p.id ,p.parent_id ,p.pool_name ,p.hs_pool_name ,CAST(p.pool_name AS CHAR(2000)) AS poolFullName FROM ip_investment_pool p WHERE p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT child.id ,child.parent_id ,child.pool_name ,child.hs_pool_name ,CONCAT(parent.poolFullName, '/', child.pool_name) AS poolFullName FROM ip_investment_pool child INNER JOIN pool_tree parent ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE child.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT p.id AS poolId ,p.pool_name ,p.poolFullName ,p.hs_pool_name FROM pool_tree p WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ip_investment_pool child WHERE child.parent_id = p.id AND child.is_deleted = 0 )
AND p.id IN
#{poolId}
ORDER BY p.id ASC

SELECT si.short_name AS securityShortName ,si.wind_code_sh ,si.wind_code_sz ,si.wind_code_nib ,si.wind_code_bj ,si.wind_code_nbc ,'' AS operationType FROM ip_pool_status ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.isin_code = ips.isin_code WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND si.isin_code NOT LIKE 'TEMP:%'
AND (si.maturity_date IS NULL OR TRIM(si.maturity_date) = '' OR si.maturity_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y%m%d'))
UNION ALL SELECT si.short_name AS securityShortName ,NULL AS wind_code_sh ,NULL AS wind_code_sz ,si.wind_code_nib ,NULL AS wind_code_bj ,NULL AS wind_code_nbc ,'' AS operationType FROM ip_pool_status_crmw ips INNER JOIN rrs_securityinfo si ON si.isin_code = ips.crmw_isin_code WHERE ips.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND ips.is_deleted = 0 AND ips.audit_status = '20' AND si.isin_code NOT LIKE 'TEMP:%' AND si.security_type = 'crmw'

SELECT al.security_short_name AS securityShortName ,al.wind_code_sh ,al.wind_code_sz ,al.wind_code_nib ,al.wind_code_bj ,al.wind_code_nbc ,CASE WHEN al.adjust_mode = '调出' THEN '删除' ELSE '' END AS operationType FROM ip_adjust_log al WHERE al.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND al.is_deleted = 0 AND al.audit_status = '20' AND al.adjust_mode IN ('调入', '调出') AND al.audit_time > #{startTime} AND al.audit_time <= #{endTime} AND al.isin_code IS NOT NULL AND al.isin_code NOT LIKE 'TEMP:%' AND (al.pool_type IS NULL OR al.pool_type != 'crmw') UNION ALL SELECT al.crmw_name AS securityShortName ,NULL AS wind_code_sh ,NULL AS wind_code_sz ,al.crmw_scode AS wind_code_nib ,NULL AS wind_code_bj ,NULL AS wind_code_nbc ,CASE WHEN al.adjust_mode = '调出' THEN '删除' ELSE '' END AS operationType FROM ip_adjust_log al WHERE al.target_pool_id = #{poolId} AND al.is_deleted = 0 AND al.audit_status = '20' AND al.adjust_mode IN ('调入', '调出') AND al.audit_time > #{startTime} AND al.audit_time <= #{endTime} AND al.crmw_isin_code IS NOT NULL AND al.crmw_isin_code NOT LIKE 'TEMP:%'
